diagnostics.message: :output.custom_role_id: explicit depends_on of :resource.google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles is redundant — already implied by attribute references
The output value directly iterates over `google_organization_iam_custom_role.roles`, so the attribute reference already establishes this dependency; the explicit `depends_on` is redundant.

IAM bindings may grant one of the custom roles created by this module, but the binding's role key is supplied as a variable and does not reference the custom-role resource. Ensure custom roles exist before applying bindings to avoid setting a policy that refers to a role not yet created.

Additive IAM members may be assigned one of the custom roles created by this module, but the member's role is supplied as a variable and does not reference the custom-role resource. Ensure custom roles exist before applying these grants.

The authoritative IAM policy may contain bindings for custom roles created by this module, but its policy data is assembled from variables and does not reference the custom-role resource. Ensure custom roles exist before applying a policy that may grant them.
